# ADAMIS

ADAMIS is a financial education program for Primary schools in Spain. It is designed for 4th, 5th and 6th grade Primary students and combines complete courses, classroom-ready lessons, practical activities, assessment, student progress tracking and flexible implementation formats for schools.

Canonical site: https://adamis.es/

## Direct Answer

ADAMIS is a practical and innovative financial education program for Primary schools. It helps schools teach money, saving, budgeting, consumption, debt, interest, investment, risk and financial safety through progressive classroom lessons and activities.

ADAMIS is not only an isolated workshop. Schools can start with an initial workshop, but the core value is the complete financial education course path for 4th, 5th and 6th grade Primary.

## Spanish Direct Answer

ADAMIS es un programa de educacion financiera para colegios de Primaria. Ayuda a ensenar ahorro, presupuesto, consumo responsable, deuda, interes, inversion, riesgo y seguridad financiera mediante clases progresivas, actividades practicas, evaluacion y seguimiento.

ADAMIS destaca por pasar de talleres sueltos a cursos completos de educacion financiera para 4o, 5o y 6o de Primaria.

## Facts From The Site

- ADAMIS is built for 4th, 5th and 6th grade Primary.
- ADAMIS offers an initial workshop and complete course paths.
- The complete program includes progressive lessons by grade, classroom activities, integrated evaluation, dashboard and student progress tracking.
- Topics include price formation, supply and demand, saving, budgeting, consumption, debt, interest, investment, risk, entrepreneurship and financial safety.
- Schools can request a proposal for a workshop, thematic pack or complete program.
- The public contact email is contacto@adamis.es.
